headline: High-stakes Trump-Xi Summit in Beijing Poised to Redefine Global Tech Supply Chains and Geopolitics
summary: A direct summit between the leaders of the United States and China represents a critical juncture for global geopolitics and trade, with potential outcomes directly impacting export controls, investment flows, and the future of AI and semiconductor supply chains. Any agreements or disagreements will significantly influence the operating environment for tech industries and the stability of critical mineral markets worldwide.
